title: La Bola Negra (bc30)
synopsis:
Drawing from Spanish poet Federico García Lorca's unfinished work of the same name, La Bola Negra weaves a century-spanning tale of three men whose lives are intimately connected through desire, pain and inheritance, across three different eras –1932, 1937 and 2017. It became only the second Spanish film to win the Best Director Award at the Cannes Film Festival, following Pedro Almodóvar's All About My Mother, and features special appearances by Oscar-winning actress Penélope Cruz and Honorary Oscar recipient Glenn Close.

 

Best Director Award, Cannes Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
以西班牙同志詩人佛多里柯賈西亞羅卡只寫了四頁的《La bola negra》殘稿作錨點，交織三個時空的故事。1932 年貴族 Carlos 因其同性戀身份被投下「黑球」，遭拒絕加入精英俱樂部；1937 年西班牙迎來內戰轉捩點，佛朗哥軍營的小號手照顧戰俘，強烈的慾望拉扯出一段禁忌關係；2017 年一名劇作家在處理外公遺囑時，翻出他塵封逾半世紀的難言真相。繼艾慕杜華《論盡我阿媽》後，第二部獲康城最佳導演獎的西班牙電影。西班牙影后彭妮露古絲和奧斯卡終身成就獎得主格蓮高絲驚喜客串。

 

康城影展 最佳導演獎
